body:
Soneium and Asseto have launched ipUSD and IP Vault, giving eligible users access to Partners Group’s $549 million intellectual-property royalties fund.

Working with Asseto , Soneium has unveiled ipUSD and IP Vault, opening eligible users to diversified royalty exposure and to the economic value of intellectual property on-chain.

ipUSD and IP Vault are now on Soneium Portal . Eligible users can take royalty-linked exposure to a diversified intellectual-property royalties fund of $549 million.

Partners Group manages the fund. Asseto provides the digital-asset infrastructure. The underlying portfolio spans 53 investments and more than 100,000 royalty streams, including royalty-linked exposure to The Weeknd’s back catalogue and music from notable artists , Discovery’s television library, and assets across pharmaceuticals, brands and the energy transition. Eligible users take that exposure by depositing ipUSD into IP Vault on Soneium Portal, lowering the entry point on a royalties strategy historically open mainly to institutional investors.

The launch extends Soneium’s Tokenized IP vision, placing the economic value of intellectual property on-chain so people can reach opportunities tied to the creative works and entertainment they know.

It also follows a move FinanceFeeds reported in September 2026, when Soneium partnered with DayOneDream to bring K-pop intellectual property on-chain through WAVIST. In May, WAVIST completed the full life cycle of a tokenized IP bond issued to finance K-pop IP, from issuance through final redemption and burning.

“When fans and investors back the IP they love, that funding moves through the Soneium ecosystem and ultimately flows back to creators and studios, giving them the freedom to take bolder creative risks. ipUSD and IP Vault open a new way to be part of that cycle. At Soneium, we are committed to growing it so that more funding goes into new stories and experiences that will resonate for generations,” said Yuji Kumagai, Head of Soneium Protocol.

Music, film and other intellectual property generate billions in royalties, yet access to the investment opportunities behind these assets has traditionally been limited.

IP Vault, through Soneium Portal, opens an asset class that has long sat out of reach for many.

“Tokenization is not only about putting an asset onchain. The real value comes when institutional assets become programmable, transferable and financeable within digital markets. Through our collaboration with Soneium, Asseto is bringing institutional-grade IP-linked products onchain and transforming royalty-linked private-market exposure into productive digital assets with broader access, utility and composability,” said Bridget Li, Co-founder and CEO of Asseto.

“Tokenization represents an important evolution in how investors access private markets. By partnering with Soneium and Asseto, we are combining the strength of institutional-quality private-market investments with blockchain-enabled distribution, providing eligible on-chain investors access to our Royalties programme through a trusted and innovative platform,” said Vincent Ng, Managing Director, Co-Head of Asia at Partners Group.

With ipUSD and IP Vault, Soneium sees intellectual property becoming a dynamic part of the global on-chain economy. Through Soneium Portal it is creating new ways to unlock IP value, introduce new forms of participation and bring that economic potential to a global audience.

ipUSD will also be available on the Startale App from launch, which FinanceFeeds has covered , so users can swap between USDSC, Soneium’s native stablecoin, and ipUSD directly in the app. The integration offers a direct route into ipUSD and into Soneium’s growing on-chain ecosystem.

ipUSD and IP Vault will be accessible on Soneium Portal from the morning of 28 October 2026, UTC.

Sony Group and Startale Group built Soneium in 2025 as an on-chain entertainment economy, with applications in music, games, anime, film, collectibles and fan creations. Tokenized IP is how the network brings intellectual property on-chain, linking creators and IP owners to new funding and to the communities behind the work, so fans and investors can share in the growth of IP they back. Made for the AI era, the network gives human creators and autonomous agents the infrastructure to build, distribute and settle IP value at scale.

Updates run through Soneium’s website , X , Discord and Telegram . Media contact: [email protected] .

Partners Group is among the largest private-markets firms in the world. It manages USD 186 billion across private equity, private credit, infrastructure, real estate and royalties. From its Swiss headquarters it employs more than 2,000 people in 25 offices worldwide, serving institutional and private-wealth investors with a broad set of private-markets solutions.

Asseto builds full-stack technology infrastructure and tokenization tools that bridge traditional finance and DeFi, taking asset owners from compliance advisory through tokenization, on-chain distribution and settlement. It launched Hong Kong’s first real-estate real-world-asset project and has deployed 14 real-world-asset products on multiple blockchains, with tokenized volume of nearly $500 million. HashKey Group backs Asseto. The firm is an alumnus of the BNB Chain MVB program and is supported by Hong Kong Cyberport.

ipUSD and IP Vault are products Soneium has launched with Asseto on Soneium Portal. Eligible users deposit ipUSD into IP Vault to take royalty-linked exposure to a $549 million diversified intellectual-property royalties fund managed by Partners Group. Asseto provides the digital-asset infrastructure. From launch, the same ipUSD can be swapped with USDSC, Soneium’s native stablecoin, inside the Startale App.

Partners Group’s fund spans 53 investments and more than 100,000 royalty streams. The mix includes royalty-linked exposure to The Weeknd’s back catalogue and music from notable artists, Discovery’s television library, and assets across pharmaceuticals, brands and the energy transition. Soneium presents it as a royalties strategy that has historically been open mainly to institutional investors.

ipUSD and IP Vault become accessible on Soneium Portal from the morning of 28 October 2026, UTC. Access is limited to eligible users. Partners Group says the partnership gives eligible on-chain investors a route into its Royalties programme through Soneium and Asseto.
